system.description:
Your Area Attacks deal more damage to one target within the area of effect.

Prerequisite: Base Attack Bonus +5

Effect: When you make a successful Area Attack with a weapon with which you are proficient, select a target hit by the attack. That target takes an additional 5 points of damage from the attack, before applying the effect of the Evasion Talent.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
